description: A 0.65 mm tube wall under minTubeWallMm 0.7: blocker. The finding reads only the measured minTubeWallMm (the warning hint also reads tubeOuterDiameterMm when it is present, see fail-warning-grown), so the tube diameters are left out rather than contradict the wall.

findings.fix: raise the tubeOuterDiameter offset or lower tubeInnerDiameter in fit profile `example-mk4s-petg-0.4` until (OD - ID) / 2 is at least 0.7 mm
findings.message: the thinnest tube wall is 0.65 mm after fit offsets, below the 0.7 mm minimum tube wall of process `fdm-0.4`
